Honest limitations

    • Tank green is close but not the hero's near-black deep green; bright studio lighting lifts it.
    • The DUCATI script decal did not render visibly in the final views — likely a shrinkwrap-projection or transparent-material issue. The decal geometry and PIL-drawn texture exist in the .blend.
    • Exhaust muffler is a simple tapered cone; the reference has weld seams, a riveted end cap, and a mounting bracket.
    • No cables, hoses, brake lines, or wiring; the cockpit (clocks, switches) is minimal.
    • Spokes are straight cylinders; the reference has slightly crossed lacing.
    • Reads as a clean stylized game asset, not a photoreal replica. Silhouette and identity features (green tank, brown seat, knobbies, gold disc, high pipe, grilled light, trellis frame, number plate) are all present.
